note: Floor per arm, in execution accuracy percent, taken as the minimum observed across the recent runs on 239 questions, and applied to the full 500-question Mini-Dev split from this release on. The floors were not re-derived at n=500 yet: they are kept as a safety net with the 4pp tolerance from ADR-166, and ratcheted after the first full-split run. A run scored on fewer than 95% of 500 questions fails as a changed sample rather than as a regression.
